Bight Sportfishing called in with 2 Swordfish and still have plenty of fishing time.
The Aztec reported in with 117 yellowfin tuna (25-60 pounds), 7 yellowtail, and 100 skipjack for day one of their Three Day trip!
The Aztec reported in with 117 yellowfin tuna (25-60 pounds), 7 yellowtail, and 100 skipjack for day one of their Three Day trip!

The Sea Watch on their 3/4 day local trip finished up with 66 Yellowfin Tuna, 21 Bullet tuna and 80 Skipjack! A 20lb flyline setup with a #4 hook or a small metal jig has been very effective for these fish! The Sea Watch has space available for next week. Come on down for some fun fall fishing!

The San Diego finished up their Full day trip with 27 Yellowfin Tuna and 92 Skipjack. Passports are Not currently required for this trip. Recommended setups for the San Diego has been a 20lb-30lb setup for live bait or small jigs.

southern_california.text: The marine pattern is improving through the seven-day period. Typical sustained wind runs 2-13 kt; morning is favored on 7 of 7 days. Combined seas range 2.0-4.0 ft with 13-15 sec periods. Best current windows: 11-10 AM, 11-11 AM, 11-12 AM. Confidence decreases after day five; recheck the latest marine forecast before departure.

central_california.text: The marine pattern is fairly steady through the seven-day period. Typical sustained wind runs 3-13 kt; morning is favored on 6 of 7 days. Combined seas range 6.0-10.0 ft with 13-15 sec periods. Best current windows: 11-11 PM, 11-10 AM, 11-12 AM. Confidence decreases after day five; recheck the latest marine forecast before departure.

northern_california.text: The marine pattern is deteriorating through the seven-day period. Typical sustained wind runs 5-24 kt; morning is favored on 5 of 7 days. Combined seas range 8.0-16.0 ft with 13-15 sec periods. Best current windows: 11-10 PM, 11-11 AM, 11-12 AM. Safety screen blocks: 11-13. Confidence decreases after day five; recheck the latest marine forecast before departure.

field_reports.name: Bayside Marine Monterey Bay Report
field_reports.summary: The same report today as yesterday. Come fishing it does not get much better in November! There are sea bass, bluefin, halibut, lingcod, bonito, crab and rock fish to catch.

field_reports.name: Fishing the North Coast
field_reports.summary: fishingthenorthcoast November 6, 2026 Eureka, Trinidad Crab Openers Delayed Due to Domoic Acid In press release issued on Nov. 6, CDFW has taken the recommendation of the CA Dept. of Public Health to delay the Dungeness crab season from he southern boundary of the Reading Rock State Marine Protected Areas (41⁰ 17.6’ N. latitude) to the southern boundary of the Ten Mile State Marine Reserve (39° 33.3’ N. latitude). This area includes Trinidad and Eureka. CDFW Statement: State health agencies have determined that Dungeness crab from the southern boundary of the Reading Rock State Marine Protected Areas (41⁰ 17.6’ N. latitude) to Cape Mendocino, Humboldt County (40⁰ 10’ N. latitude) pose a human health risk due to elevated levels of domoic acid and recommended a delay of the recreational Dungeness crab fishery. Following this recommendation, California Department of Fish and Wildlife (CDFW) Director Meghan Hertel has delayed the recreational Dungeness crab fishery in this area. This follows action taken by Director Hertel on Oct. 30 to restrict the use of recreational crab traps due to entanglement risk and delay the opening of the fishery in southern Humboldt County/northern County d

field_reports.name: Dockside Depoe Bay Daily Report
field_reports.summary: We had amazing Lingcod fishing this morning on the Tacklebuster and the Surfrider. Both vessels had over 30+ Lingcod for each boat. That is a whole bunch of the "toothy critters". The rockfish were also biting with really good scores on them as well. We have one more day of good ocean weather tomorrow and then the ocean seems to be blowing up again the start of next week. It looks like lots of swell hitting the area next week and beyond for the beginning of November. Keep in touch with our office for weather changes or trips scheduled.

field_reports.name: Shake N' Bake Ilwaco Report
field_reports.summary: We went back to the same spot as the day before and found birds and jumpers. We stopped on birds and our sonar lit up but the fish would not bite, except for three dumb ones. What a hit or miss year. ​Mike C 10/12. Good fishing.
